fields.description: One policy per line. The agent treats each line as a hard rule - it must refuse the action and explain why if this is violated. Example: "Never discount a first-time customer."
fields.label: Strict (must refuse if violated)

fields.description: One policy per line. The agent still proceeds, but flags it clearly to the person. Example: "Flag any leave request longer than 10 days."
fields.label: Warning (proceed, but flag it)
